Specimen

Every token at actual size. Generated from tokens.json — @archetype/design-system v1.0.0. Contrast ratios are measured by the same maths the build enforces.

Color

Target ratio 90% stone, 8% verdigris, 2% bronze. Ratios shown against stone-50 and stone-900.

stone

stone-50Canvas #FAF8F5 on canvas 1.00 · on ink 16.70 Default page ground. The warm off-white that replaces #FFFFFF everywhere
stone-100Chalk #F1EEE8 on canvas 1.09 · on ink 15.29 Secondary surface, sunken sections, raised cards on canvas
stone-200Limestone #E3DED4 on canvas 1.26 · on ink 13.21 Sunken ground, subtle hairlines, disabled control fill
stone-300Ash #CFC8BC on canvas 1.57 · on ink 10.66 Structural hairline, card frame, secondary action border
stone-400Pumice #A8A199 on canvas 2.41 · on ink 6.93 Emphasis border, disabled text. NOT a type color at any size
stone-500Stone #877F76 on canvas 3.72 · on ink 4.49 Metadata on light grounds, rules, tertiary text at display sizes only
stone-600Slate #635C55 on canvas 6.21 · on ink 2.69 Reading copy, eyebrow, caption. The lightest tint that carries body text
stone-700Graphite #45403B on canvas 9.67 · on ink 1.73 UI text, body-sm, emphasis. Holds serif hairlines at 15px
stone-800Basalt #2B2724 on canvas 13.97 · on ink 1.20 Secondary dark ground, primary action hover
stone-900Ink #1A1816 on canvas 16.70 · on ink 1.00 Display and heading type, primary action ground, dark page ground

verdigris

verdigris-100 #DCE6E2 on canvas 1.20 · on ink 13.88 Cool tint surface, callout ground
verdigris-300 #8FAFA5 on canvas 2.24 · on ink 7.46 Accent on dark grounds, dark-mode link
verdigris-500 #517D71 on canvas 4.38 · on ink 3.81 Muted accent, border and icon only. 4.38:1 on canvas — not body copy
verdigris-700 #2E5349 on canvas 8.09 · on ink 2.07 PRIMARY ACCENT. Links, active and selected states, focus ring
verdigris-900 #1B342E on canvas 12.56 · on ink 1.33 Accent hover, text on cool tint, dark-mode cool surface

bronze

bronze-100 #EDE0CC on canvas 1.23 · on ink 13.60 Warm tint surface. Sparing
bronze-300 #CDAF83 on canvas 1.97 · on ink 8.48 Warm accent on dark grounds
bronze-500 #A9834F on canvas 3.28 · on ink 5.10 Warm hairline on dark. 3.00:1 on chalk — never type there
bronze-700 #7D5C33 on canvas 5.74 · on ink 2.91 Warm accent. A hairline, a small mark, a single emphasized word
bronze-900 #4A361E on canvas 10.78 · on ink 1.55 Text on warm tint, dark-mode warm surface

Type

13 roles. Display cut at 27px and above, text cut at 20px and below, nothing sans between. Rendered in proxy faces — Archivo and Source Serif 4 — so line breaks are arbitrary and the two sans optical cuts render identically.

Radius and elevation

Sharp by default. Pills are reserved for status badges and radio controls. Cards rest on a border, never a shadow.
